name: CopyablePrompt - Inline
description: The one-row tone, and the only one that truncates. It exists for the finished-plan screen, where the reattach strip has to fit on a single row or it takes a quarter of the summary someone came back to read. The text here is the longest of any CopyablePrompt scenario on purpose - the truncation IS the behaviour, so a short string would capture as an ordinary untruncated pill and prove nothing. The full text stays selectable and is still what the button copies; only the sight of it is clipped.
